args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I like that you have a clean, simple personal site. One suggestion: it's currently quite minimal — it would be great to see more about who you are, your background, interests, or projects you're working on. Also, you might want to consider adding a contact form or more details beyond just your email. Overall, a nice start — keep building on it!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog is centered around hiking — that's a wonderful hobby with so much to write about! I'd suggest adding more content, like trail reviews, hiking tips, photos from your adventures, or gear recommendations. It would also be nice to see some structure like categories or recent posts to help readers navigate. Looking forward to reading more of your hiking stories!
